# Investor pack demo (`export-ready/demo/`)

**Maintainer folder.** Shipped external zips include **only** `TravelTrust-Product-Demo-v1.3.mp4` when ready—not this README or `SCREEN-RECORDING-BRIEF.txt`.

## External send policy

The shipped mp4 **must** be the final **~90s** one-take capture per **`SCREEN-RECORDING-BRIEF.txt`**. **Do not** include placeholder/slate reels in an external zip.

If the real video is not ready: **omit** the `.mp4` from the zip and state that in email; label **demo / testnet vs production** in-frame or VO when you do ship a capture.
